go-jsonschema generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type User

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "object",
  "description": "A user record.",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "name":     {"type": "string"},
    "age":      {"type": "integer"},
    "nickname": {"type": "string"}
  },
  "required": ["name", "age"]
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/userpkg

go 1.26
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestUser_RoundTripRequired(t *testing.T) {
	in := []byte(`{"name":"alice","age":30}`)
	var u User
	if err := json.Unmarshal(in, &u); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if u.Name != "alice" || u.Age != 30 || u.Nickname != nil {
		t.Errorf("got %+v, want {Name:alice Age:30 Nickname:nil}", u)
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(u)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Marshal: %v", err)
	}
	if string(out) != `{"age":30,"name":"alice"}` {
		t.Errorf("Marshal = %s, want %s", out, `{"age":30,"name":"alice"}`)
	}
}

func TestUser_RoundTripOptional(t *testing.T) {
	nick := "ali"
	u := User{Name: "alice", Age: 30, Nickname: &nick}
	out, err := json.Marshal(u)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Marshal: %v", err)
	}
	want := `{"age":30,"name":"alice","nickname":"ali"}`
	if string(out) != want {
		t.Errorf("Marshal = %s, want %s", out, want)
	}
	var v User
	if err := json.Unmarshal(out, &v); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if v.Nickname == nil || *v.Nickname != "ali" {
		t.Errorf("Nickname = %v, want pointer to \"ali\"", v.Nickname)
	}
}

func TestUser_MissingRequired(t *testing.T) {
	var u User
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"name":"alice"}`), &u)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: err = nil, want missing-required-field error")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "missing required field") {
		t.Errorf("err = %q, want missing-required-field message", err)
	}
}

func TestUser_RejectUnknownMember(t *testing.T) {
	var u User
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"name":"alice","age":30,"extra":1}`), &u)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: err = nil, want unknown-member error")
	}
}
